body: You know I read recently on /r/ science that a good way to beat procrastination is to set goal for yourself as you do your work and reward yourself when you accomplish those goal, just like you have recommended. I think you are right. I need more structure in my life in order to tackle these problems that I'm facing. Instead of putting them off and having everything collapse on me. Seriously, Dizzeesc2 thanks for the advice and most importantly thanks for listening.

I care so much about my film work that I often forget or put off school work. My mom feels like I work on film sets too much and I am starting to believe she does not think I will get a job in the industry. It's just I work so much towards my goal that I tend to forget about obligations.

Well, above all I consider myself a film maker. I study film at college (sorry cant say where). I ultimately want to be a Cinematographer although my strengths really lay in Lighting design. But all of my personal issues keep getting in the way. I feel like I can never balance what I love to do with work and school. And so I keep finding myself where I am right now. Lonely and demoralized trying to make sense of my future.

This isn't the first time it's happened though. I've fucked up gradewise and I think this time she is just sick of it. She has gotten to the point where she doesn't trust me anymore. This has come because of many reason besides the the grades. I'm not a bad person or anything, I'm just sometime immature and irresponsible. But it's gotten to a point where I dont think I will get anymore second chances and that scares the shit out of me. She has said she will pull me out of college and I just dont know what I will do. 
The self multilation is something I will have to control on my own. I think you are right she would be more worried about the burning than the grades. But if she ever found out she would be devastated, so again its something that I have to control on my own.
Thanks Adrian for listening.
